name: votum
description: A bot-resistant endorsement system for GitHub repositories.

scripts.extension:pack: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path dist\extension\votum-extension.zip) { Remove-Item dist\extension\votum-extension.zip -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path extension\* -DestinationPath dist\extension\votum-extension.zip -CompressionLevel Optimal"
